new_ops.name: transformer_xl_relative_attention
new_ops.replaces: absolute positional encoding + standard causal attention
new_ops.reason: Transformer-XL relative attention adds position-dependent terms to the attention logits for each query/key pair. These come from relative-distance embeddings projected per head, plus learned global content and position bias vectors. The relative distance is clamped at 2048. A new attention primitive is needed that computes a [T,T] per-head logit term from relative offsets. The paper gives no details of the embedding form, the bias vectors or the projections beyond the citation.
new_ops.quote: we use the relative positional encoding scheme from \citet{dai2019transformer} rather than absolute positional encodings.

output.notes: Described the headline Gopher 280B; all six family configs are listed. The architecture is GPT-2 with RMSNorm in place of LayerNorm and Transformer-XL relative positions in place of absolute ones. The following are marked inherited from GPT-2 via the inheritance sentence, not restated in the paper: pre-norm placement, GELU activation (GELU form not specified, so approx is left not_stated), sequential residual blocks, dense causal attention, tied output embedding, final norm, and n_kv_heads = n_heads. d_ff is derived from the stated rule 4×d_model; the quoted caption does not contain the numeric values. The Bias-only fine-tuning text 'Introduce attention biases' hints that the pretrained model may lack attention biases, but this is not explicit, so qkv_bias is left not_stated. The norm eps and the details of the relative encoding are not given.
